verdict.rationale: Apple's docs claim all-day-class battery life for M4 Pro machines: up to 22 hours of video streaming on the spec page and up to 24 hours across the M4-family MacBook Pro line, plus 'legendary power efficiency'. Nothing shows M4 Pro shipping in fanless or thin, quiet designs, and the battery figures are vendor-only 'up to' numbers that aren't specific to M4 Pro configurations. Missing for 10: evidence of fanless or low-power chassis designs, evidence of thin or quiet operation, independent or hands-on battery-life testing, and M4 Pro-specific battery figures.
